## RCA (Phase 1 complete) — confirmed root cause

**Mechanism (runtime-confirmed).** In `PydanticAIRunner.run()` (src/rebar/llm/runner.py) the
finalization tail runs `log_call_success(...)` → `result = _findings.finalize_outcome(...)` →
`_merge_success_run_shape(...)` → `record_call_spend(...)`, all AFTER the ProviderSession
`with` and the agent-call `try/except/finally` have exited. `record_call_spend` is the last
statement. When `finalize_outcome` raises (e.g. schema validation on a structured/
verify_completion call whose model call already succeeded and burned tokens), the exception
propagates straight out of `run()` before `record_call_spend` executes, so no spend row is
written to usage.jsonl / the billable sink. `log_call_success` (emitted before finalize) does
fire, so the loss is silent — cost reporting undercounts real token spend.

**Proof (discriminating experiment).** The c465 characterization test monkeypatches
`finalize_outcome` to raise and `record_call_spend` to capture calls, drives `run()`, and
observes: the "llm call ... ok in" success log DID fire, and `spend_calls == []` — i.e.
record_call_spend never ran. Rewriting that assertion to demand exactly one spend row makes the
test RED against current code (`assert 0 == 1`) for exactly this reason, GREEN after the fix.

**Legitimacy = defect.** Authority: bug 8455 established the invariant "a call that burned
tokens must leave a spend row even on the failure path" (fixed for the agent-call except
boundary); `record_call_spend`'s own docstring ("Durable spend record for the weekly billable
CI jobs"); and this ticket's acceptance criteria. This finalize boundary is the mirror gap
8455's fix did not reach.

**Attribution (`caused_by` = 8455-a818-f305-4748), class = preexisting (omission).** The
ordering (spend recorded after finalize, unguarded) predates the ADR-0056 extraction: commit
`8b44b5aa50ee` (ticket 5e75) moved the inline `usage_log.record` spend line into
`record_call_spend` as an explicit "Pure relocation: no behaviour change", preserving the
position. There is no commit that *broke* previously-working behavior — the finalize-raise path
never recorded spend — so this is an omission, not a regression. It is attributed by
scope-of-work to bug **8455** (`8455-a818-f305-4748`, commits c179971eab2d / fc3fc19787a6,
"record usage for a failed LLM call"): 8455 is the ticket that introduced the failure-path
spend contract and whose scope should have covered this mirror boundary. Recorded as
`preexisting` because the gap existed independently of and prior to 8455's partial fix.

**Fix.** Wrap `finalize_outcome` in `try/except Exception: record_call_spend(...); raise`. This
records the spend row for the already-consumed tokens on the finalize-failure path and re-raises
the original exception unchanged (disposition preserved — the caller still sees the ValueError).
The failure-path row carries the authoritative token counts (known before finalize); it omits
the success-only `_merge_success_run_shape` enrichment (which needs the finalized result),
exactly mirroring 8455's agent-call except-path row. The SUCCESS path is byte-identical:
`record_call_spend` still runs last, after the shape merge, so the success spend row is
unchanged. Options (b) "move record_call_spend before finalize" and try/finally were rejected
because both reorder the success path and would strip the run-shape data (aec1) from the
success spend row.

**Scope & safety.** Single call site for `record_call_spend` (the run() chokepoint — its
docstring notes it is "the one chokepoint shared by both the external tier and the live
prompt-eval"), so no construct siblings. No parity siblings (the fake/override runners burn no
tokens). Caller-dependency sweep: nothing depends on the ABSENCE of a spend row on the finalize
path — only the c465 characterization test pinned the gap, updated here per AC. Restoration not
creation; no new dependency; the touched test is strengthened (gap → fix), not weakened.

**Test (RED→GREEN, held-out, teeth).** `tests/unit/test_pydantic_ai_runner.py::
test_a_raise_in_finalize_outcome_still_logs_and_records_the_spend_row` (renamed from the
characterization test per AC). Seen RED first (`0 == 1`), GREEN after fix; mutation check
(re-introducing the unguarded ordering, run under an OS sandbox) returns it to RED. Full runner
suite (33) + lint + typecheck green.

## Final report (Phase 2 complete — landed & closed)

**Problem.** `record_call_spend` (LLM spend accounting) was silently skipped when
`finalize_outcome` raised in `PydanticAIRunner.run()` — a call that already burned tokens left
no spend row.

**Proven root cause.** In `PydanticAIRunner.run()` (src/rebar/llm/runner.py) the finalization
tail ran `log_call_success` → `finalize_outcome` → `_merge_success_run_shape` →
`record_call_spend`, with `record_call_spend` as the *last, unguarded* statement after the
ProviderSession `with` and the agent-call `try/except/finally` had exited. A raise from
`finalize_outcome` (schema validation on a structured/verify_completion call whose model call
already succeeded) propagated straight out before `record_call_spend` ran. `log_call_success`
fires beforehand, so the loss was silent.

**Proof (discriminating, runtime).** The c465 characterization test monkeypatched
`finalize_outcome` to raise and captured `record_call_spend`: the success log fired yet
`spend_calls == []`. Demanding exactly one spend row made it RED (`0 == 1`) for precisely this
mechanism, GREEN after the fix. Mutation check (re-introduce the unguarded ordering, run under
an OS sandbox) returned it to RED — the test has teeth.

**Defect origin.** `caused_by = 8455-a818-f305-4748` (bug "record usage for a failed LLM
call", commits c179971eab2d / fc3fc19787a6), `close_class = preexisting`. Attribution by
scope-of-work: 8455 introduced the failure-path spend contract but only covered the agent-call
except boundary; this finalize boundary is the mirror gap it never reached. No commit *broke*
working behavior (the finalize-raise path never recorded spend → omission, not regression); the
ordering predates the ADR-0056 extraction (`8b44b5aa50ee`, "pure relocation"). `caused_by` edge
recorded on close via `--caused-by`.

**Test (RED→GREEN, held out).**
`tests/unit/test_pydantic_ai_runner.py::test_a_raise_in_finalize_outcome_still_logs_and_records_the_spend_row`
(renamed from the c465 characterization test per AC #2). Seen RED first, GREEN after; held out
from the fix.

**Fix.** Wrapped `finalize_outcome` + the success-only tail (`result["_usage"] = usage`,
`_merge_success_run_shape(...)`) in a `try:`, and moved `record_call_spend(...)` into a
`finally:`. On the success path the finally still runs last (after the shape merge), so the
success spend row is byte-identical incl. run-shape enrichment; on a finalize raise the
success statements are skipped, the finally records the token-count spend row, and the original
exception propagates unchanged (disposition preserved). runner.py stays at 797 LOC (< 800 cap).

**Scope & safety.** Single call site for `record_call_spend` (the run() chokepoint) → no
construct siblings; fake/override runners burn no tokens → no parity siblings. Caller-dependency
sweep: nothing relied on the absence of a spend row on this path (only the c465 characterization
test pinned the gap, updated here). Restoration not creation; no new dependency; the touched
test was strengthened (gap → fix), not weakened.

**Siblings.** None (Axis 1 construct sweep: single chokepoint; Axis 2 parity census: no other
token-burning surface).

**Residual risk & prevention.** None observed with a citation beyond this fix.

**Replication.** Original report no longer reproduces: `make lint` + `make typecheck` + full
suite green locally; Gerrit change **2417** landed with `LLM-Review +1` AND `Verified +1`
(GitHub Actions run 33296445574 all green: macOS + ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 pytest, lint,
typecheck, bounded mutation gate), then plain Submit → MERGED.

**Change:** https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2417 — closed `preexisting`,
`caused_by 8455-a818-f305-4748`.

## Coordination note for epic eb64 (runner/reconciler/operation-boundary convergence)

**Timing:** the eb64 conflict-avoidance guidance reached me *after* this fix had already landed
and this ticket was closed, so I could not hold it for sequencing. Recording exactly what is now
on `main` so eb64 can rebase onto it and preserve the invariant rather than re-introduce the gap.

**Landed commit:** `44e34af1065d3e084e73a58c223a9fd7a0e44783` on `origin/main`
("Record LLM spend when finalize_outcome raises", `rebar-ticket: fe75-a4a3-9eef-457c`,
Change-Id `Ic904f7a80d969596e8543a91ca8c641c504b7023`, Gerrit change 2417, LLM-Review +1 /
Verified +1). Gerrit's Rebase-If-Necessary submit rebased my patch cleanly onto latest main.

**Single-file blast radius (in eb64's declared `src/rebar/llm/` territory):**
- `src/rebar/llm/runner.py` — `PydanticAIRunner.run()` finalization tail, ~lines 728–767.
  The ONLY structural change: `finalize_outcome(...)` + the success-only tail
  (`result["_usage"] = usage`, `_merge_success_run_shape(...)`) are now inside a `try:`, and the
  pre-existing final `record_call_spend(...)` moved into a `finally:`. No lines added/removed
  elsewhere; success path is byte-identical (finally fires last, after the shape merge).
- `tests/unit/test_pydantic_ai_runner.py` — the c465 characterization test renamed to
  `test_a_raise_in_finalize_outcome_still_logs_and_records_the_spend_row`, asserting the fixed
  behavior.

**Invariant eb64 MUST preserve through any runner-lifecycle refactor:** when `finalize_outcome`
(or any post-model finalization step) raises after the model call has consumed tokens,
`record_call_spend` still runs exactly once for that call before the exception propagates, and
the original exception's disposition is unchanged. The regression test above is the guard — keep
it green. Did NOT touch `failure.py` / `_errors.py` / `gate_dispatch.py` (error-code epic 3405's
territory).

If eb64 is rewriting `run()`'s finalization such that a straight rebase is non-trivial, treat
this as the source-of-truth for the required behavior; ping me if you'd like me to re-apply the
ordering on top of the refactored shape.

## Context

Discovered during ticket c465 (PydanticAIRunner lifecycle revalidation, epic
financial-stoneware-brant). In `PydanticAIRunner.run()` (src/rebar/llm/runner.py), the
finalization/spend-recording tail runs strictly AFTER both:
- the `with ProviderSession(...) as provider_session:` block has exited (runner.py:452-708),
  and
- the failure-accounting `try/except/finally` around the agent call (runner.py:605-707).

Concretely: `log_call_success` (:716) fires, THEN `_findings.finalize_outcome` (:725) runs,
THEN `record_call_spend` (:751). If `finalize_outcome` raises (e.g. schema validation failure
on a structured/verify_completion call), the exception propagates raw out of `run()`:
- `log_call_success` already fired (by design — its docstring explicitly wants this).
- `record_call_spend` NEVER fires — the call already burned real tokens but leaves no spend
  row in usage.jsonl / the billable-CI sink.
- `interpret_failure`/`usage_log.record_failure`/`step_failures.record` are also skipped,
  since they live inside the already-closed except block around the agent call, not around
  finalize_outcome.

This is the mirror case to bug 8455 (a raise DURING the agent call itself, which
`usage_log.record_failure` in the except block now covers) — but 8455's fix does not reach
this later boundary.

A characterization test pinning this CURRENT behavior was added in c465's landed change:
`tests/unit/test_pydantic_ai_runner.py::test_a_raise_in_finalize_outcome_still_logs_but_skips_the_spend_row`.

## Problem

A structured/verify_completion call that succeeds at the model level but fails schema
validation in `finalize_outcome` silently loses its spend attribution — undercounting real
token spend in cost reporting with no error surfaced for the loss itself (the ValueError/
schema error IS raised to the caller, but nothing signals the missing spend row specifically).

## Approach (not yet designed — this ticket is to decide and implement a fix)

Options to weigh: (a) wrap `finalize_outcome` so a spend row is recorded before propagating its
raise (mirrors bug 8455's discipline for the agent-call except block); (b) move
`record_call_spend` earlier, before `finalize_outcome`, if usage/token counts are already known
at that point (they are — `usage` is populated before `log_call_success`); (c) some other
narrow fix. Whatever is chosen must not duplicate ProviderSession/ExitStack, must not introduce
a generic hook/plugin bus, and must be proven with a RED-before-GREEN test derived from the
characterization test above (which pins CURRENT behavior and must be updated to pin the FIXED
behavior once this bug is resolved).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] A raise in `finalize_outcome` still results in a spend row being recorded for tokens
      already consumed by the call.
- [x] `test_a_raise_in_finalize_outcome_still_logs_but_skips_the_spend_row` (or its replacement)
      is updated to assert the FIXED behavior (spend row present) rather than the gap.
- [x] No regression to the existing failure-accounting path for a raise during the agent call
      itself (bug 8455's coverage).

Update the c465 characterization test to assert the FIXED behavior: a raise in finalize_outcome still records exactly one spend row.
